title: Debounce Higher-Order Function with Clean Types
explanation: Postpones the execution of an expensive callback until after a specified period of inactivity has elapsed. Essential for search auto-complete inputs, window resizing, and scroll tracking.
caveat: Preserves the 'this' context by avoiding an arrow wrapper on the returned function. Remember to cancel timers in React useEffect cleanup routines.

variations.label: Immediate (leading-edge) execution
variations.code: function debounceImmediate(fn, delay) { /* executes immediately then cools down */ }

variations.label: Throttle equivalent (at most once per N ms)
variations.code: function throttle(fn, limit) { /* enforce max execution frequency */ }
